Liam (CS): FYI HelixHealth bridge tomorrow 09:00 PT. Account health flagged: trial usage spiking then plateauing, renewal in ~40 days. They reported slow first-token latency after idle periods. Need a slim playbook: prefill/warmup, prefix caching, adaptive batching, streaming fallback, and a short post-call feedback capture.

Sofia (Eng): Proposal: delta-prefetch for most-used prompts (top 8), adaptive batching with max latency 30ms and max batch size 16, streaming on with end_stream_on_error toggle. Suggest synthetic warmup 40m prior with 40 concurrent prefill requests and KV-cache validation. Sample run command to share with CS: 
```bash
# warmup script (synthetic requests)
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/route/helix-prod/warmup \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
    -d '{"prompt":"<sample>"}' &
done; wait
```

Ravi (SRE): Add SRE constraints: enforce route-level timeout 5s, slow-start throttle at 100rps for the first 10m, and enable per-route error-rate SLO `route_errors/1m < 3%`. I'll add a shortbook entry for the pager policy and a one-off canary to a smaller model if latency > 800ms median.

Clara (PM): I'll own the customer checklist and feedback capture. Post-call we ask three items: 1) latency OK? 2) quality OK? 3) anything blocked? Link to short feedback form will be sent within 30m of call. I'll tag renewal risk in the CRM if sentiment is negative.

Liam (CS): Can WarmupBot trigger the job and log cache hits so we can confirm KV warming? Also want to confirm whether private deploy needs extra kv size.

WarmupBot: Warmup scheduled by Sofia: job_id=wh-1755556666, run_at=2026-04-02T08:20:00Z, concurrency=40, route=helix-prod. Logs will be available in /warmups/wh-1755556666. :white_check_mark:

Sofia (Eng): For private customers recommend KV cache 768MB for larger context sets and quantized int8 model when available. For hosted, prefer l-series with reserved burst for call windows. Also set prefix cache TTL 12m and max_async_prefill=64.

Ravi (SRE): I'll add Prometheus snippets to the runbook: `sum(rate(redwood_route_latency_bucket{route=\"helix-prod\"}[2m])) by (le)` and an alert when p50>600ms for 3m. Plus a runbook action: if p95>1200ms, switch route to fallback-model.

Clara (PM): Action items recap: Sofia schedules warmup and posts final script, Ravi adds alerts & runbook entries, Clara builds feedback form and ties to CRM renewal tag, Liam will run pre-call checklist 20m prior and ping this thread when done.

Liam (CS): Thx all. I'll paste the quick customer-facing checklist below before EOD so support team can rehearse.
